# LLM / VLM for Driving

<!-- generated from data/llm-vlm.yaml; do not edit by hand -->

Approaches that use (multimodal) LLMs for driving decisions, explanation, or scene understanding.
Models that output trajectories/actions end-to-end from a VLM backbone live in [VLA](vla.md).

**21 entries**, newest first within each section. Add papers by editing `data/llm-vlm.yaml` (see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).

## LLM as Planner / Decision Maker

- **DriveMLM: Aligning Multi-Modal Large Language Models with Behavioral Planning States for Autonomous Driving**: [Link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.09245)
- **A Language Agent for Autonomous Driving**: Agent-Driver: [Link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10813) · *COLM 2024*
- **LanguageMPC: Large Language Models as Decision Makers for Autonomous Driving**: [Link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.03026)
- **Driving with LLMs: Fusing Object-Level Vector Modality for Explainable Autonomous Driving**: Wayve: [Link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.01957) · *ICRA 2024*
- **GPT-Driver: Learning to Drive with GPT**: Planning as language modeling: [Link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.01415) · *NeurIPS-W 2023*
- **DiLu: A Knowledge-Driven Approach to Autonomous Driving with Large Language Models**: [Link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.16292) · *ICLR 2024*
